record.question: Which of the following best explains the meaning of school administration?
options: Management of educational institutions with a view to foster teaching-learning
Administration assisting in the realization of the aims and objectives of education
Management of all school operations, from creating a safe learning environment to managing the school budget
Management of things and human relationship for the betterment of education
record.explanation: School administration is fundamentally the management of things and human relationships for the betterment of education.
